lines.text: The Holy Spirit said to set apart Barnabas and Saul, so the church fasted, prayed, and laid hands on them.
Sent by the Holy Spirit, Barnabas and Saul sailed from Joppa to Cyprus and proclaimed God's word in Salamis synagogues.
Elymas opposed them, so Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, said Elymas would be blind for a time.
When the proconsul saw what happened, he believed, for he was astonished at the teaching about Moses.
